g.text: Predefined two-thirds-depth intervention · paired 95% t intervals
Small dots: individual seed differences. Separate x scales and task-specific loss units. Intervals are not multiplicity-adjusted.
ViT pruning lowers CE in every recipe: a positive paired effect means a smaller CE improvement after dropout.
